job_name.help: Input file name without extension, also used for intermediate files

excited_state_forces.help: BSE state (e.g. s1, t1) whose analytic nuclear forces are computed after the BSE and stored in the orb file (closed shell, fixed QP corrections; needs dftpackage.xtpdft.compute_forces true)

qp_gradients.help: Quasiparticle levels whose analytic nuclear energy gradients dE/dR are computed after GW and stored in the orb file (qp_gradients, qp_gradient_levels), e.g. for vibronic line shapes of photoemission spectra: a comma-separated list of levels or ranges relative to homo or lumo, or absolute MO indices (0-based), e.g. homo-3:lumo+3 or homo,lumo or 30:40. The levels must lie in the QP window. Closed shell, perturbative QP energies, G0W0 or evGW with sigma_integrator ppm or exact (otherwise, or with excited_state_forces_qp_response false, the gradients are those of the KS energies); with mpsfile the frozen external multipoles are included. Degenerate levels get the gradient of their mean energy.

relaxed_density.help: State (e.g. s1, t1, or a perturbative QP level such as pqp5) whose relaxed density matrix is computed after GW-BSE and stored in the orb file (relaxed_density, relaxed_density_state): ground-state density plus the relaxed difference density of the analytic gradient, i.e. with orbital relaxation (Z-vector) and, with excited_state_forces_qp_response, the response of the QP corrections (G0W0 or evGW with sigma_integrator ppm or exact). For a QP level the density of the system with the electron added or removed. Closed shell, xtp DFT package with an auxiliary basis, no ECPs, no truncation or environment screening; external multipoles (mpsfile) are kept fixed. Needs no derivative integrals.

excited_state_forces_follow.help: excited_state_forces: orb file of an earlier geometry with excited-state forces; the forces are then computed for the state of the same type with the largest exciton overlap with that state (root following in geometry optimizations), instead of the state of excited_state_forces

excited_state_forces_qp_response.help: excited_state_forces: include the response of the QP corrections (sigma_integrator ppm or exact, G0W0 and evGW); false keeps them fixed

mpsfile.help: MPS file to read from with external multipoles for embedding. The ground-state and excited-state forces and the QP gradients then include the interaction with these sites (frozen moments), and the forces on the sites are stored in the orb file (site_forces, excited_state_site_forces)

guess.help: File to read the wave function if the use guess flag is set to true

moguess.help: Orb file to read ONLY the MOs from (geometry still comes from job_name.xyz, or from guess if that is also set) -- for warm-starting a geometry optimization step's own SCF from a PREVIOUS step's converged wavefunction at a different geometry, which guess itself cannot represent since it loads geometry and MOs together from the same file.

tasks.help: task to compute. gradients (alone): no DFT or GW-BSE run; the gradients requested with qp_gradients and/or excited_state_forces are computed from the data of an earlier run in job_name.orb (same options as that run) and added to the file; QP gradients of levels that are already stored are kept

logging_file.help: File to send logging data to.
